analysis.reasonEn: RSI is hovering at 49.4 in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram is worsening at -0.6042. ADX at 27.4 indicates a clear trend, but -DI at 29.5 is stronger than +DI at 20.1, suggesting a weak trend. Volume ratio at 0.86 of the 5-day average shows a lack of momentum. The current price of $331.98 is above SMA20 ($329.10) but below SMA50 ($345.96), approaching resistance. The 4H RSI at 51.5 is neutral but has turned up from 28.6 five bars ago, and the 4H MACD histogram is improving at 0.8047. The overall market stance is 'risk management' awaiting CPI data. Given these mixed signals and a prevailing weak trend, a wait-and-see approach is prudent.
